activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a quick shower
Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Dressing in work clothes, checking the phone for the severe storm warning and packing the work bag
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Arriving at the ward, changing into scrubs and reviewing the patient handover notes
Working the morning shift: patient assessments, medication rounds and clinical documentation
Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal in the staff room
Continuing clinical duties: monitoring patients, coordinating with the care team and updating records
Commuting home after the shift while the storm clouds build
Washing hands and face and changing out of work clothes
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and storing leftovers in the refrigerator
Storm preparation: charging the phone and computer, filling the kettle and closing the windows
Relaxing and watching TV while listening to the storm outside
Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
Winding down, setting the alarm on the phone and reading before sleep
